text: Ok that works. Now, one more step here in the painting proceedure, when i go to press compile and install the asset to the game, it does not seem to carry the painted texture to the game world, it does the shape
resolution: Cooked Studio props now carry their painted texture into BOTH the iso3D editor and the compiled game (user-confirmed both). Three layers: (1) the Compile-Asset cook now passes the model's paint atlas (texRef + blob) through cookProp/install — it was hardcoded untextured. (2) Editor render: CookedProp samples the atlas via Scene3D.Mesh's inline texture={{width,height,hex}} door (decode PNG, downscale 512, memoised hex; the host content-hash-caches the upload) — the first textureKey+<Paintable> attempt fell back to the 1x1 white default. (3) Compiled game: MESH_PROPS lump bumped to v3 carrying each mesh's 512² RGBA atlas; constructor.decodeMeshProps reads it into MeshPropMesh.tex_rgba; world_loader sets scene3d_tex_w/h/rgba on the prop node and whitens the tint — mirroring the player/NPC textured-mesh path, so gpu/3d.zig samples it with no new GPU code. OBJ/GLB imports ship 0x0 (untextured), unchanged. Also fixed two upstream blockers found en route: paint persistence across model-switch/restart (shared-texture per-model reload, req_1488/1492) and the paint-kit integration itself.
